exploitation_evidence.source: CISA KEV catalogue; KEV to ATT&CK mapping by MITRE CTID; FIRST EPSS scores of 2026-10-04 (probability of exploitation in the next 30 days). KEV vulnerabilities are already exploited, so their EPSS is high (median about 0.49, against about 0.007 for all published vulnerabilities). scenarios.name: Cloud tenant takeover through token theft or malicious application consent
scenarios.statement: An attacker steals session or OAuth access tokens, or tricks a user or administrator into consenting to a malicious cloud application, and uses the granted permissions to read mail and files, add privileged roles and persist in the organisation's cloud tenant without needing passwords or MFA again.
weaknesses: Users can consent to third-party cloud applications without administrator review
Long-lived tokens not bound to device or revoked on risk
